# Echo Playground

> A local Go/Echo reference REST API with JSON/CBOR, Firebase-owned profiles,
> cursor pagination, and anonymous read-only GitHub projections.

This application is not deployed. GCP is a possible future target. From the
repository root, copy `.env.example` to `.env` and run `just run`; the default
local origin is `http://localhost:8080`. Public operations and documentation
work without Google credentials. Profiles need the local Firebase emulators
and an emulator ID token, as described in the complete guide.

From a running application's origin, retrieve `/.well-known/api-catalog` and
resolve its root-relative links against that retrieval URL. The catalog links
the runtime OpenAPI contract, both guides, and health. `/health` also advertises
the catalog and OpenAPI through typed HTTP links. These public documents grant
no access to protected operations.

## API usage

- [Complete usage guide](llms-full.txt): Curated, self-contained reference for broad or offline retrieval, including requests, profile CRUD, local credentials, and recovery.
- [Local runtime OpenAPI](http://localhost:8080/openapi.json): Contract for the default local server; replace the origin when running on another address.
- [Committed OpenAPI JSON](https://github.com/janisto/echo-playground/blob/main/api-docs/swagger.json): Repository-readable generated schemas and exact operation constraints.
- [README examples](https://github.com/janisto/echo-playground/blob/main/README.md): Human onboarding and local emulator commands.

## Implementation reference

- [Application composition](https://github.com/janisto/echo-playground/blob/main/cmd/server/application.go): Middleware ordering and public/protected routing.
- [Documentation routes](https://github.com/janisto/echo-playground/blob/main/internal/http/docs/docs.go): Same-build schema, guides, catalog, and Swagger UI.
- [Versioned routes](https://github.com/janisto/echo-playground/blob/main/internal/http/v1/routes/routes.go): Hello, items, GitHub, and current-principal profiles.
- [Authentication](https://github.com/janisto/echo-playground/blob/main/internal/platform/auth/middleware.go): Firebase bearer verification and ownership context.
- [Persistence](https://github.com/janisto/echo-playground/blob/main/internal/service/profile/firestore.go): Atomic profile create, transactional updates, and existence-preconditioned delete.
- [OpenAPI normalization](https://github.com/janisto/echo-playground/blob/main/cmd/openapi/main.go): Native Swag validation and deterministic OpenAPI 3.1.2 output.
